linkedPullRequests.title: [dualtor] Add icmp_responder
linkedPullRequests.author: lolyu
linkedPullRequests.body:
Add icmp_responder that runs over ptf to reply ICMP echo-request packets
sent by the ToR's LinkProber to simulate a physical server.

Signed-off-by: Longxiang Lyu <lolv@microsoft.com>

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Simulate the physical servers for dualtor testbeds that could reply ICMP echo-request(heatbeat).

#### How did you do it?
Add a service `icmp_responder` to `ptf` container.

#### How did you verify/test it?
demo test
```python
import pytest
from tests.common.fixtures.ptfhost_utils import run_icmp_responder


pytestmark = [
    pytest.mark.topology("any"),
]


TARGET_SERVER = "192.168.0.100/21"
DUT_PORT = "Ethernet8"


@pytest.fixture(scope='function', autouse=True)
def setup_intf(ptfhost):
    ptf_port = "eth2"
    ptfhost.shell("ifconfig %s %s" % (ptf_port, TARGET_SERVER))
    yield ptf_port
    ptfhost.shell('ifconfig %s 0.0.0.0' % ptf_port)


@pytest.fixture(scope="function", autouse=True)
def disable_ping(ptfhost):
    ptfhost.shell("echo '1' > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/icmp_echo_ignore_all")
    yield
    ptfhost.shell("echo '0' > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/icmp_echo_ignore_all")


def test_icmp_responder(duthost):
    duthost.shell("ping 192.168.0.100 -c 10")

```
